notes.title: Inkression Demo is now Live!
notes.content:
[b]Inkression's Demo is now Live![/b]

This demo is ~30-45 minutes long and showcases the intro to the game's story, the main mechanics, and the first character's gameloop. 

There currently isn't a save system for this version yet as we are working on testing and polishing it, but if you played through the first ~10 minutes or so of the game and decide to come back to it later, [u]press and hold R[/u] to skip the first cutscene in the game. 

We hope you enjoy this demo, and if there are any bugs, questions, feedback that you'd like to share with the dev team, please either [url=discord.gg/QcdEzHmFTu] Join our Discord server [/url] or [url=inkression@brokencigs.com] Email us[/url]!

Thank you for your interest in Inkression, and stay tuned as we continue developing the game!

Sincerely,
BROKENCIGS
